candidates.change_summary: Remove the proposalCount increment so proposals no longer increase proposalCount.
Change the increment to +2 so proposalCount grows by two per proposal.
Change the increment to a decrement so proposalCount decreases per proposal.
Assign USDV address to VADER instead of _vader.
Assign VAULT address to VADER instead of _vader.
Assign address(0) to VADER instead of _vader.
Delete the assignment VADER = _vader so VADER stays address(0).
Move the assignment USDV = _usdv before VADER = _vader and swap values so VADER gets _usdv (swap of the two assignment statements).
Delete the statement `USDV = _usdv;` so USDV remains address(0) after init.
Assign VADER's value to VAULT instead of the _vault parameter.
Assign USDV's value to VAULT instead of the _vault parameter.
Delete the assignment to VAULT, leaving it address(0).
Set VAULT to address(0) instead of _vault.
Remove the assignment 'coolOffPeriod = 1;' so coolOffPeriod remains 0 after init.
Change the assignment to 'coolOffPeriod = 2;' so coolOffPeriod differs after init.
Change the assignment to 'coolOffPeriod = block.timestamp;' so coolOffPeriod gets a timestamp value instead of 1.
